name: Violinisant
look: a tall elegant green bird with a white crest and ruff, an orange face mask, a long orange beak it plays like a violin with a twig bow, an orange-flamed chest, a green wing cape and long tail streamers
entry: It plays its long beak like a violin, drawing a twig across it as a bow. Its performances move listeners to tears, and those who heckle it find themselves unable to stop dancing.
how: Evolve Arpsant at level 36. It learns Psychic Noise when it evolves.
